description: This file declares and defines an interface for LZ77 decompression used in Mikrotik WLAN driver. It contains a function prototype for decompressing data when the corresponding feature is enabled, and a stub inline function returning 'operation not supported' otherwise.

methods.name: int rb_lz77_decompress(const u8 * in,const size_t in_len,u8 * out,size_t * out_len)
methods.description: Performs LZ77 decompression of input data into an output buffer, returning 0 on success or a negative error code.
